Transit fares: one-proportion confidence interval公交票价：单比例置信区间

A transit agency asks riders whether the new fare policy is fair. Follow one random sample from the question to the interval to a conclusion with the correct scope, and watch which standard error each procedure needs.公交机构询问乘客新票价政策是否公平。沿着一个随机样本，从问题、区间到适用范围恰当的结论逐步核对，并留意每种程序需要哪种标准误。

Data and calculator assumption数据与计算器假设

Synthetic educational example created for this course: a random sample of 120 city riders with 72 in agreement. No external observations or real rider records.本课程编制的合成教学示例：120 名城市乘客的随机样本中有 72 人认同；不含外部观测或真实乘客记录。

Assumption: TI-84 Plus CE, OS 5.7, MathPrint on, STAT WIZARDS off. Text values below are rounded transcriptions, not exact screen formatting.假设：TI-84 Plus CE，OS 5.7，MathPrint 开启，STAT WIZARDS 关闭。下列数值为四舍五入后的文字转录，不表示屏幕的精确排版。

This is a worked process, with rounded numeric transcriptions. It is not a calculator emulator or screen image. Conceptual checks are labeled separately.这是逐步讲解，数值为四舍五入后的文字转录，并非计算器模拟器或屏幕截图。概念核验单独标注。

Use ← and → to step. Printing includes every step in the selected language.使用 ← 和 → 逐步浏览。打印时显示所选语言的全部步骤。

1. Define the question1. 明确问题

Conceptual setup概念设置

Question: estimate the proportion of all city riders who agree the new fare policy is fair. A random sample of 120 riders finds 72 in agreement.问题：估计全部城市乘客中认为新票价政策公平的比例。120 名乘客的随机样本中有 72 人认同。

Parameter: p = the true proportion of city riders who agree; statistic: p-hat = 72/120 = 0.60参数：p = 全部城市乘客中认同的真实比例；统计量：p-hat = 72/120 = 0.60

Name the population, the parameter, and the observed count before computing. The interval estimates the population proportion p, not the proportion in this sample.计算前先命名总体、参数与观测计数。区间估计的是总体比例 p，而不是本样本中的比例。

2. Check the conditions2. 核验条件

Conceptual check概念核验

Conditions: random sample; 120 riders is less than 10% of the city's riders; n(p-hat) = 72 and n(1 - p-hat) = 48 are both at least 10.条件：随机样本；120 人不到全市乘客的 10%；n(p-hat) = 72 与 n(1 - p-hat) = 48 均不小于 10。

Random sampling, the 10% condition, and the large-counts condition all pass for this sample.随机抽样、10% 条件与大计数条件对本样本均通过。

The large-counts check uses the observed successes and failures, 72 and 48. An interval cannot repair a biased sampling method, so the random-sample condition is the one to state out loud.大计数核验使用观测到的成功与失败次数 72 与 48。区间无法弥补有偏的抽样方法，因此随机抽样条件必须明确写出。

3. Choose the procedure and standard error3. 选择程序与标准误

Method selection方法选择

Procedure: one-proportion z-interval, at STAT then TESTS then A:1-PropZInt. Standard error SE = sqrt(p-hat(1 - p-hat)/n), built from the sample proportion.程序：单比例 z 区间，位于 STAT → TESTS → A:1-PropZInt。标准误 SE = sqrt(p-hat(1 - p-hat)/n)，由样本比例计算。

For 95% confidence the critical value is z* = 1.959963985, the middle-95% quantile of the standard normal distribution.95% 置信水平对应的临界值 z* = 1.959963985，即标准正态分布中间 95% 的分位数。

An interval uses the unpooled standard error from p-hat, and 1-PropZInt asks for no null value. A confidence interval has no H0 and no p-value; a test would use the null value instead.区间使用由 p-hat 得到的未合并标准误，且 1-PropZInt 不需要原假设取值。置信区间没有 H0，也没有 p 值；检验才会使用原假设取值。

4. Enter the values and read the screen4. 输入数值并读取屏幕

TI-84 keys and transcriptionTI-84 按键与转录

STAT, arrow right to TESTS, choose A:1-PropZInt, type x:72, n:120, C-Level: .95, select Calculate, then ENTER.按 STAT，右移到 TESTS，选择 A:1-PropZInt，输入 x:72、n:120、C-Level: .95，选择 Calculate，再按 ENTER。

Screen transcription (rounded): (.51235, .68765), p-hat = .6, n = 120屏幕转录（四舍五入）：(.51235, .68765)、p-hat = .6、n = 120

Enter the count 72, not the proportion 0.60; x must be a count of successes. The first output line is the interval, and p-hat appears on the line below. Transcribed values are rounded, not exact screen formatting.输入计数 72，而不是比例 0.60；x 必须是成功次数。输出的第一行是区间，p-hat 在下一行。转录数值经过四舍五入，不代表屏幕的精确排版。

5. Reproduce the interval by hand5. 手算复核区间

Hand calculation手算复核

SE = sqrt(0.60(0.40)/120) = 0.0447 (rounded); margin of error = 1.959963985(0.0447) = 0.0877 (rounded); interval = 0.60 plus or minus 0.0877.SE = sqrt(0.60(0.40)/120) = 0.0447（四舍五入）；误差范围 = 1.959963985(0.0447) = 0.0877（四舍五入）；区间 = 0.60 ± 0.0877。

SE = 0.044721359549995794; margin = 0.08765225407822756; interval = (0.5123477459217725, 0.6876522540782275), which rounds to (0.5123, 0.6877).SE = 0.044721359549995794；误差范围 = 0.08765225407822756；区间 = (0.5123477459217725, 0.6876522540782275)，四舍五入为 (0.5123, 0.6877)。

The hand calculation reproduces the screen interval, so the two agree. The margin of error covers sampling variability only, and only under the stated conditions.手算复现了屏幕上的区间，两者一致。误差范围只在所述条件下覆盖抽样变异。

6. Interpret within the design6. 在设计范围内解释

Conceptual conclusion概念结论

Report the interval, the confidence level, and the population it describes.报告区间、置信水平，以及它所描述的总体。

We are 95% confident that the true proportion of all city riders who agree the new fare policy is fair is between about 0.512 and 0.688 (51.2% to 68.8%).我们有 95% 的把握认为，全部城市乘客中认为新票价政策公平的真实比例约在 0.512 与 0.688 之间（51.2% 至 68.8%）。

95% confidence describes the method: about 95% of intervals built this way would capture p. That is not the probability that this particular interval is correct, and the interval says nothing about an individual rider.95% 置信描述的是方法：用这种方式构造的区间约有 95% 会覆盖 p。这并不是这个特定区间正确的概率，区间也不描述任何单个乘客。
